title: GET /research/desk/micro/snapshots discloses what it excludes (withheld_excluded + stale_excluded)
hypothesis: micro_snapshots.list_snapshot_meta drops rows twice over WITHOUT a count: it skips every unresolved-pool (withheld) dataset id (micro_snapshots.py:376-381) and it silently drops any stored meta that fails load-time identity re-verification (its own docstring: 'silently excluded'), so the route can serve [] while 18 .meta.json files sit on disk and no reader can tell 'never built' from 'built then invalidated by an algo/format/feature-source/fingerprint move' from 'withheld because it belongs to the sealed pool'. Every sibling enumerator already discloses its exclusions -- GET /research/datasets serves sealed_withheld, GET .../snapshots/compute serves withheld_excluded, readiness renders micro-readiness-withheld-excluded -- so this one route is the odd one out, and a UI section over it would be misleading rather than honest. Fix additively at the one owner via the shared exclude_withheld choke point (never a per-snapshot-file-derived count, which would leak sealed-pool build state).
journey_sketch: Serve withheld_excluded and stale_excluded (computed after the withheld filter, by the existing choke point) beside `snapshots`, and render them in the new Feature Snapshots section -- promoted jointly with micro-snapshots-surface as J-12.
